description: This PHP class 'ParamRuleCollection' manages a collection of parameter validation rules for API request parameters, including handling exclusions, strictness, and validation rules.

classes.name: ParamRuleCollection
classes.description: A class that manages a collection of parameter validation rules, including adding, removing, and configuring validation behavior.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the collection with optional ParamRule objects.

methods.name: getParamValidations
methods.description: Returns all parameter validation rules as an array.

methods.name: setParamValidations
methods.description: Sets multiple parameter validation rules, replacing existing ones.

methods.name: addParamValidation
methods.description: Adds a single ParamRule to the collection, throws exception if duplicate key.

methods.name: removeParamValidation
methods.description: Removes a ParamRule by parameter key, returns the removed rule or null.

methods.name: isStrict
methods.description: Returns whether strict validation is enabled.

methods.name: getMap
methods.description: Returns the internal map of parameter validation rules.

methods.name: getExcludedParamKeys
methods.description: Returns the list of excluded parameter keys.

methods.name: setExcludedParamKeys
methods.description: Sets the list of excluded parameter keys.

methods.name: addExcludedParamKey
methods.description: Adds a single key to the list of excluded parameter keys.
